# Rough draft: results key numbers (generated by analysis/rough_draft/01_results.py)

Method v4: the course exponential method (Lesson 12, Recitation 12). Baseline: 55 C, mission 2,920 h (8-year EV battery warranty x 1 h/day, A7), Ea 0.7 eV, target R(mission) >= 0.999 with 95% confidence (at most 343 FIT for the system). Every number is the estimate with its 2.5th-97.5th percentile unless it is a bound. Case study: all six slots, realistic quantities per vehicle (A17), Sheet2 prices.

## Data caveat
Results show the reliability **demonstrated by the qualification tests in our parameter table**. The RH850 has one 231-device test here, while Renesas's published FIT rests on far more data, so it is probably more reliable than shown. Our table gives the ADI parts lower FITs than ADI publishes, so they may be optimistic (R2).

## R2 Validation against published FITs
- TI parts: our 60% bound / published = 0.68-1.16 (6 parts; 1 = reproduced). C2000: 6.21 vs published 6.19.
- R7F7016903AFP-C: calculated 15.3 vs published 0.0011 (verified): calculated higher than published
- LTC6811-1: calculated 0.318 vs published 34 (verified): calculated lower than published
- ADuM141E: calculated 0.448 vs published 20.2 (not checked): calculated lower than published
- ADuM4135: calculated 0.373 vs published 11.3 (not verified): calculated lower than published

## R3 Coverage of the course 95% interval (10,000 synthetic suppliers with known true FIT)
- Central 95% interval contains the true FIT: 98.4%; true FIT below the 97.5th percentile: 99.5%; 48% of the synthetic tests had zero failures.

## R4 Picks (55 C, 2,920 h, per 1,000 vehicles)
- Most reliable: F280049CPZQR + BQ79656PAPRQ1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1: system FIT 10.1 (0-53.5); 95% max 43.5 vs 343 -> meets target: yes; failures per 1,000 0.0294 (0-0.156); purchase $273,600
- Safest: F280049CPZQR + BQ79656PAPRQ1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1: system FIT 10.1 (0-53.5); 95% max 43.5 vs 343 -> meets target: yes; failures per 1,000 0.0294 (0-0.156); purchase $273,600
- Cheapest meeting target: F280049CPZQR + LTC6811-1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1: system FIT 11.5 (0-61); 95% max 49.5 vs 343 -> meets target: yes; failures per 1,000 0.0335 (0-0.178); purchase $268,600
- Least reliable (the 'before' choice): R7F7016903AFP-C + LTC6811-1 + ADuM141E + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + ADuM4135 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1: system FIT 19.7 (0.0112-105); 95% max 85.1 vs 343 -> meets target: yes; failures per 1,000 0.0574 (3.27e-05-0.306); purchase $286,060
- Combinations evaluated: 16; meeting the target: 16. Least reliable / most reliable system FIT: 1.95x.

## R5 Temperature
- Highest temperature (5 C steps) at which the target is still demonstrated: after (most reliable) 80.0 C; before (least reliable) 70.0 C.

## R7 What the tests can demonstrate (per part, over 2,920 h at 55 C)
- Parts demonstrating under 1 ppm at 95%: 0 of 10; on the estimate: 7 of 10.
- 1 ppm with zero failures needs 8.75e+09 equivalent device-hours at 55 C; our tests are 1.1-146 times too small.

## R8 Life models tried (internal comparison, shown as one table)

- Weibull beta 0.8 (defects): most reliable F280049CPZQR + BQ79656PAPRQ1 + ISO7741QDWRQ1 + TMP4719QDGSRQ1 + UCC21750QDWRQ1 + TMCS1101A4UQDRQ1; same picks as the exponential: 3 of 3 (Most reliable, Safest, Cheapest meeting target); most reliable system AFR 19.4 FIT
